# Running muxt check before the first muxt generate reports route templates
# as waiting for generated handlers, not as unused, and does not flag the
# partials those routes reference.

! muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
Route templates with no generated handler; run muxt generate to wire them up:

Error: fail: 1 error

{{template "greeting" .}}
{{end}}

-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Home(_ context.Context) string { return "" }
